{{Quote|Tell me where the prisoners are housed.''"<br />"''Uh, each of the twenty-four zones has a worker restraint facility.|[[Galen Marek]] and a [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]]|<ref name="TFUn">[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed'' novelization]] {{Ab|Star Wars: The Force Unleashed (unabridged audiobook)}}</ref>}}
'''Sector N-Seven''',<ref name="DS" /> also referred to as '''N7''', was one of twelve equally-sized zones on the northern hemisphere of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]], a massive [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]] built by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Like the other twenty-three sections on the [[Space station/Legends|space station]], the zone covered 31.4 [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] of the Death Star's circumference, was commanded from a [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]], and contained a number of sectors with designated purposes.<ref name="DSTC" /> The Death Star, including zone N7, was destroyed in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].<ref name="Destruction date" /> Zone N7 bordered zones [[N6]] and [[N8]].<ref name="DSTC" />

Zone N7 contained [[City Sprawl North 7: A68]]. The [[City/Legends|city]] [[sprawl]] was home to the [[A68 Market]], the largest and most active network of [[black marketeer]]s on the Death Star.<ref name="DSTC" />
